reaction: It was interesting that gas could leave the spiral without colliding or burning.

mostWorthwhile.text: The dense-gas collision was most worthwhile: its compression and cooling gave a clear contrast with the stars passing between one another.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the outer cloud was the least engaging decision because it was the only gameplay action left, although its result added a distinct gas outcome.

surprise.text: The outer cloud could be drawn out without entering the main collision.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed a star or gas component through the encounter.

continue.text: Yes. The contrasting outcomes for stars and gas made me curious about what happens to the material next.
